description: This file defines the 'webPlatform' object implementing the 'Platform' interface for web environment, including methods for hashing, GUID generation, logging, and configuration flags.

methods.name: calculateSha1
methods.description: Asynchronously computes the SHA-1 hash of a given text string using the Web Crypto API.

methods.name: createGuid
methods.description: Generates a new GUID (Globally Unique Identifier) as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: isLogEnabled
methods.description: Checks if logging is enabled for a specific channel or API name.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages to the console with a specified channel or API name.

methods.name: showInternalStackFrames
methods.description: Returns a boolean indicating whether internal stack frames should be shown.
